title: Understanding Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum $$L$$ is given by the formula $$L=I\omega$$, $$where$$ $$I$$ is the moment of inertia and $$\omega$$ is the angular velocity.

title: Moment of Inertia for a Rod
text: The moment of inertia $$I$$ for a rod rotating about its center is given by $$I=(1/12)mL**{2}$$, $$where$$ $$m$$ is the mass and $$L$$ is the length of the rod.

title: Calculating Angular Velocity
text: Angular velocity $$\omega$$ can be calculated using $$\omega=2\pi{}f$$, $$where$$ $$f$$ is the frequency in revolutions per second.

title: Calculate the Moment of Inertia
text: Calculate the moment of inertia for the propeller using the formula $$I=(1/12)mL**{2}$$. $$Remember$$ $$to$$ $$consider$$ $$the$$ $$mass$$ $$and$$ $$length$$ $$of$$ $$both$$ $$blades$$.
